title: Expedition 33 Maelle Build - Best Skills & Weapons
description: Complete Maelle build guide for Expedition 33 covering her Stance mechanic, best skills, weapons like Medalum and Jarum, Pictos, and team synergies.

sections.title: Maelle Overview & Stance Mechanic
sections.content:
Maelle is the third party member, joining Gustave and Lune at The Manor in Flying Waters. She's the youngest member of the expedition with no known immediate family. In battle, she wields a sword with a focus on Physical and Fire damage, plus strong support options.

The Stance System

Maelle's defining mechanic is her three-tier Battle Stance system:

StanceEffectBest For
DefensiveReduced damage taken, +1 AP on parry/dodgeSurviving tough encounters, AP farming
OffensiveIncreased damage dealt, increased damage takenTransition to Virtuose, applying debuffs
VirtuoseMaximum damage output, no meaningful downsideDealing damage — your goal state

Key mechanic: Every time Maelle switches between any stance, she gains +1 AP. This means stance transitions are never wasted — even switching for utility generates resources.

The optimal strategy is reaching Virtuose Stance as quickly as possible and staying there. Weapons like Medalum (starts in Virtuose) and Jarum/Lithum (switch to Virtuose on counterattack) make this much easier.

sections.title: Best Skills
sections.content:
Top Offensive Stance Skills

  • Fencer's Flurry: AoE attack that applies Defenseless to all enemies. Ideal as a first-turn opener — pair with Speed to ensure Maelle acts first.
  • Guard Down: Applies Defenseless to all enemies for 3 turns. Alternative to Fencer's Flurry when you want to skip damage and just debuff.
  • Guard Up: Party-wide Shell buff. Incredible when combined with Greater Shell, Longer Shell, and Powerful On Shell Luminas.
  • Rain of Fire: Solid damage that stacks Burn for residual damage over time.
  • Burning Canvas: Late-game skill that rewards Burn-focused party setups with enormous damage scaling.
  • Breaking Rules: Extremely situational but completely shuts down shield-stacking enemies.

Top Defensive Stance Skills

  • Sword Ballet: The go-to boss nuke for Luck/Critical builds. Hits the damage cap early and scales incredibly well. Your primary single-target damage skill.
  • Phantom Strike: Late-game AoE nuke. Stack Energising Start and Energising Turn Pictos to fuel its AP cost.
  • Pyrolyse: Ultimate Burn-stacking attack. When used from Offensive Stance, applies 21 baseline stacks of Burn — devastating with Burn synergies.

Top Virtuose Stance Skills

  • Last Chance: High risk, high reward setup for massive nukes. Loop with Sword Ballet for devastating turns.

Stanceless Skills

  • Fleuret Fury: Locks Virtuose Stance, multi-hit with Break potential. Solid all-rounder.
  • Stendhal: Good damage with self-debuffs that becomes a massive nuke in late game.

Gradient Attacks

  • Virtuose Strike: Low cost, multiple hits. Combine with Sword Ballet for a destructive turn.
  • Phoenix Flame: Clutch party-save skill when facing potential wipes.

sections.title: Recommended Weapons
sections.content:
Medalum — Early Game Essential

Automatically starts Maelle in Virtuose Stance every fight, maximizing damage from turn one. Also boosts Burn damage, synergizing with her Fire skills.

How to get: Beat the Gestral Arena's final fight as Maelle. This is the ONLY way to get Medalum before postgame — do not skip this!

Jarum — Mid-Late Game (Burn Focus)

Continues the Burn-stacking strategy with an incredible bonus: switches to Virtuose Stance on Counterattack at Level 4. With consistent Parrying, you'll stay in Virtuose permanently without spending skill slots on stance-switching.

How to get: Defeat the Chromatic Jar boss on the island west of Gestral Village on the world map.

Lithum — Late Game (Mark Focus)

Capitalizes on Marked enemies for amplified damage. Like Jarum, grants Virtuose Stance on Counterattack (Level 10). Best paired with characters who apply Mark consistently (Gustave, Verso).

How to get: Defeat Alicia in The Reacher area, accessible at Maelle relationship level 5.

Facesum — Alternative (Burn Build)

Another Burn-synergy weapon option for dedicated Fire damage builds pairing Maelle with Lune's Immolation.

Weapon Progression

Medalum (Gestral Arena) → Jarum (Chromatic Jar) → Lithum (The Reacher). Switch based on whether your party focuses on Burn application or Mark application.

sections.title: Pictos & Lumina
sections.content:
Core Pictos for Maelle

PictosEffectPriority
Painted PowerRemoves 9,999 damage capMandatory (postgame)
Energising Start I-IVBonus AP at battle startHigh — fuels expensive skills
Full StrengthFlat damage increaseHigh — direct multiplier
Augmented Counter I-IIIStronger counterattacksHigh — pairs with Jarum/Lithum
Glass CanonDamage boost (risk: more damage taken)Medium — Virtuose already exposes you
ImmaculateDamage increaseHigh — from Mask Keeper in Visages

Burn Build Luminas

  • Critical Burn: Burn ticks can critically hit — enormous DPS increase
  • Burn Affinity: Increased Burn damage
  • Healing Fire: Burn damage heals Maelle — excellent sustain

Shell Build Luminas

  • Greater Shell: Increases Shell strength from Guard Up
  • Longer Shell: Extends Shell duration
  • Powerful On Shell: Damage boost while Shell is active — turns defense into offense

General Priority Luminas

  • Energising Start (all tiers)
  • Energising Turn
  • AP Discount

sections.title: Build Synergies
sections.content:
Maelle + Lune (Burn Combo)

The strongest early-game synergy in the game. Lune uses Immolation to Burn an enemy, then Maelle uses Swift Strike to enter Virtuose Stance on her first turn. Stack Rain of Fire, Pyrolyse, and Burning Canvas for scaling Burn damage. Equip Critical Burn, Burn Affinity, and Healing Fire Luminas for maximum effect.

Maelle + Verso/Sciel (AP Support)

Both Verso and Sciel can generate additional AP that helps Maelle stay in Virtuose Stance longer. More AP means more skill uses per turn, which means more damage. Verso's Marking Shot also sets up Maelle's Mark-dependent skills and Lithum weapon bonus.

Maelle + Anyone (Defenseless Debuff)

Fencer's Flurry applies Defenseless (25% more damage from ALL sources) to all enemies. This benefits your entire party for 3 turns. Use on turn one for maximum party-wide damage amplification.

Solo/Lone Wolf Maelle

With Last Stand Pictos (Accelerating, Empowering, Critical, Protecting) from the Hidden Gestral Arena, plus Solo Fighter, Maelle becomes an incredible Lone Wolf fighter. Virtuose Stance damage with Last Stand bonuses creates a self-sufficient powerhouse.

sections.title: Advanced Tips
sections.content:
• Speed matters: Maelle applying Defenseless on turn one with Fencer's Flurry amplifies ALL subsequent party damage by 25%. Invest in Agility or Speed Pictos to ensure she acts first.
  • Parry religiously: In Defensive Stance, Parry grants +1 AP. With Jarum or Lithum equipped, Parrying also triggers Virtuose Stance — free damage mode from defense.
  • Stance switching generates AP: Don't fear switching stances mid-fight. Every switch grants +1 AP, making transitions profitable even without dealing damage.
  • Sword Ballet is your boss killer: On Luck/Crit builds, Sword Ballet reaches the damage cap easily and scales absurdly once Painted Power removes the cap.
  • Guard Up is underrated: Party-wide Shell sounds defensive, but with Powerful On Shell Lumina, it becomes a party-wide damage buff that also protects.
  • Breaking Rules is niche but essential: Some late-game enemies constantly regenerate shields. Breaking Rules completely shuts this down — keep it available for swap-in.
  • Phantom Strike for groups: Stack Energising Start and Energising Turn to afford Phantom Strike's high AP cost. It one-shots most non-boss groups in late game.
